slides.notes: Wait for the room to settle. Say the one-liner, then click.
Ask who has already had an AI generate slides. Most hands go up.
This slide has fragments: each → reveals one command. Deckhand asks the slide first, the slide answers handled:true. Last → changes slide.
Insist on 'no build step': a folder is enough. deck.json is optional.
Show the phone. Trigger the laser on the thumbnail. Show the QR for 15 s on the stage.
Ask the room to scan. Watch the viewer count climb. Detach, then come back to live.
Free: rooms up to 30 viewers. Paid plan for bigger rooms. Self-host if you prefer.
Leave the repo URL on screen. Stop the timer.
